name: Shibata (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shibata town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Shibata, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 December 1961.

features.role: Shibata town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a five-pointed star
